title: cuscuta papillosa
intro: Cuscuta papillosa, commonly known as dodder, is a parasitic flowering plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the vascular tissues of other plants. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta papillosa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Cuscuta papillosa include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
